paper.title_en: Exploring Exact Einsteinian Black Hole Physics in Dark Matter Environment: Ray Tracing, Stability, Eikonal QNMs and Thermodynamics
paper.abstract_en: Motivated by the recent rebuttal of black hole--dark matter solutions based on velocity-matching, we reconstruct the spacetime by treating the dark matter halo density directly as an energy-density source in the Einstein field equations. We obtain an exact static, spherically symmetric black hole solution and investigate the effects of the halo on its geometry, optical properties, quasinormal modes, and thermodynamics. Using null geodesics, we show that the halo modifies photon trajectories, shifts the circular photon orbit, and enlarges the photon sphere and apparent shadow. The Lyapunov exponent of the unstable null orbit further determines the eikonal quasinormal modes, yielding explicit halo-induced corrections to their oscillation and damping rates. We also compute the mass, Hawking temperature, entropy, heat capacity, and Gibbs free energy to characterize the thermodynamic stability and phase structure. We find that the dark matter halo enlarges the domain of thermodynamic stability and introduces nontrivial phase behavior absent in the Schwarzschild case, demonstrating that astrophysical dark matter environments can leave potentially observable imprints on black hole observables.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在爱因斯坦场方程中直接以暗物质晕密度为能量密度源，构造出精确的静态球对称黑洞解，并系统研究其几何、光学、准正规模与热力学性质。理论深度较高，方法路线清晰，对黑洞热力学相结构与暗物质环境可观测印记有潜在价值，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 在暗物质环境中探索精确的爱因斯坦黑洞物理：光线追踪、稳定性、程函准正规模与热力学
decision.abstract_zh: 受近期基于速度匹配对黑洞-暗物质解的驳斥的启发，我们通过将暗物质晕密度直接视为爱因斯坦场方程中的能量密度源来重构时空。我们获得了一个精确的静态、球对称黑洞解，并研究了晕对其几何、光学性质、准正规模和热力学的影响。利用零测地线，我们表明晕改变了光子轨迹，移动了圆光子轨道，并增大了光子球和表观阴影。不稳定零轨道的李雅普诺夫指数进一步决定了程函准正规模，给出了对其振荡和阻尼率的显式晕诱导修正。我们还计算了质量、霍金温度、熵、热容和吉布斯自由能，以刻画热力学稳定性和相结构。我们发现暗物质晕扩大了热力学稳定域，并引入了施瓦西情形中不存在的非平凡相行为，表明天体物理暗物质环境可以在黑洞可观测量上留下潜在可观测的印记。
